content: Apple Developer Forums (thread 739712): daemons/launchd background agents cannot obtain Core Location authorization at all -- CoreLocationAgent (which renders the permission prompt) does not present UI for a headless agent/daemon process; the documented workaround is a global launchd AGENT (not a LaunchDaemon) run as the logged-in user, but Apple's modern SMAppService API does not support installing global launchd agents, narrowing the path further. Matches this repo's own #99 framing: 'headless CoreLocation TCC is the spike.'
